conversion_rules: Use the existing cumulative complete-source Pandoc adapter only after binding the terminal Gamma-I baseline.
Retain every original file byte and ordered mathematics payload. Convert full Markdown AST, prefix every generated anchor, record each source-to-reader heading and ordered math-node map.

For standalone TeX remove only document wrapper/title, retain the entire body, insert a local group for zero-argument macros, and shift section hierarchy. Existing theorem/proposition environments in main already suffice.

Literal equation tags and mathematical strings remain exact. Any subsequent line-breaking edit requires a reversible per-node TeX layout record; do not normalize notation or silently repair original sources.
Display typed leading-line and dagger-domain corrections in the complete audited continuation and crosswalk; original source appendices remain historical witnesses.
Do not use the shorter EW Markdown in place of its full TeX body. No source or proof is replaced by a summary.

For the complete original pasted sources, rewrite sandbox download links only through an explicit URL-to-retained-archive-path map in the derivative reader; preserve the raw pasted source bytes and every mathematical node.
Root updates title overview, complete conclusion, theorem crosswalk, reader indexes and build/dependency records, then builds and visually verifies all added pages and affected pagination.
